metadata.greeting_note: ATTRIBUTION OVERRIDE (established 2026-07-31, carried forward from 09-04-01 and 09-04-02): hosted by Sai in his own name, not by Liam-in-for-Bear. Voice stays Kokoro am_onyx. metadata.note: WEEKLY PROGRESS REEL for the loon-detector project, week of 2026-09-11. NO TEAMMATE IS NAMED ANYWHERE, by the author's explicit instruction: collaborators appear as 'we' and 'the team', never by name, in narration, on-screen text, SOURCES.md and PEDAGOGY.md alike. THE WEEK, as reported by the author: the first iteration of LoonNet is trained on 106 images and validated against ~26 held out from the same repository; he supplied two YOLO prediction mosaics, val_batch0_pred.jpg and val_batch1_pred.jpg; he flagged three weaknesses (duplicate detections, one section of land read as a loon, and a training set that is too small); a dedicated false-positive evaluation has NOT been run; precision/recall/accuracy from the model are NOT yet available and are promised before the team meeting. He also proposed an order for seven application features and recommended keeping CVAT rather than building an annotation tool. THROUGH-LINE: the seven failures are not one failure. Four distinct causes sit behind them, and only some are fixed by more data — which is why the reel refuses to average them into a single score. FIGURES — READ THIS BEFORE CHANGING ANY NUMBER ON SCREEN. Author-supplied: 106 training images, ~26 held out. Printed by the YOLO plotter in the supplied mosaics and therefore quotable verbatim: every per-frame confidence (0.3 ... 0.9) and the two class names, 'common loon' and 'non loon'. EVERYTHING ELSE IS A HAND AUDIT performed by reading the two sheets cell by cell: 26 populated frames (16 + 10), 28 loons visible, 19 frames clean, 7 frames with a defect, ~26 of 28 loons found. These are NOT model metrics. No precision, recall, mAP, F1, IoU, epoch count, image size, batch size or confidence threshold appears anywhere in the reel, because none were supplied. B07's fourth artifact line states the hand-audit caveat in full and must not be cut. A FOURTH WEAKNESS IS ON SCREEN THAT THE AUTHOR DID NOT LIST: in val_batch1_pred.jpg, web_20260818_0076.jpg shows two loons in fog and the model returned no detection at all. The author reviewed this and approved including it. TWO CLASSES, NOT ONE: 'non loon0.8' is visible in val_batch0_pred.jpg r4c4, so this model was trained to reject as well as accept. That is why B01 carries two class chips and why B05's ghostText says the false-positive test comes first. ONE CLAIM DELIBERATELY NOT MADE: val_batch1_pred.jpg r4c2 (web_20260818_0107.jpg) appears to show a Black Guillemot on a rock, detected as a common loon at 0.7. It is NOT counted as a false positive anywhere and is not on any plate — the identification is not certain enough to put on screen. It is logged in SOURCES.md as a data-quality item for the author to verify. ILLUSTRATE LAW: Claude UI at B00, B08 and the verdict/outro only. Body beats run ChipGrid -> STILL -> DivergentFates -> STILL -> BinaryBranch -> ChipGrid; no two consecutive beats share a pattern. SHORTS / 9:16: ClaudeScienceLayerStack and ClaudeScienceSourceFlow — the guide's default B01/B02 patterns — have NO registered 916 sibling and are avoided for that reason alone. Every Remotion pattern used here does have one (ClaudeComposerAsk916, ClaudeScienceChipGrid916, DivergentFates916, BinaryBranch916, ClaudeVerdictArtifact916, LogoOutro916), so shorts.py rewires with no new TSX. B02 and B04 are user media and would otherwise be centre-cut; both carry hand-composed pantry/<beat>-916.png plates from make_plates.py and both hold rather than pan. B06 is dropped from the short (--drop B06): the 9:16 cut is model results only. NARRATION CARRIES NO POSITIONAL REFERENCE ('top left', 'the third one') because the same mp3 plays over both the landscape and portrait plates and the cell order differs. B04's narration says 'the first' rather than 'top left' for exactly this reason. typeScale 1.4 on the two deck patterns, which were authored against a 1280x720 stage; the 916 siblings take {data} only and ignore it harmlessly. Deck-pattern label and detail strings are kept under ~42 characters — fixed-x SVG text does not reflow, so a long string overprints silently and Remotion still exits 0. OUTRO: LogoOutro, not ClaudeTitleOutro, whose handle is hardcoded to @NikBearBrown. B09 narration is 8 words so it finishes inside the 4.0s card before its fade — see the _contract_note on that beat. `./art run` will print a SKIN LINT line asking for ClaudeTitleOutro; it is wrong for this channel and is expected.
metadata.voice_note: metadata.voice (legacy) is deliberately ABSENT. build_safety.default_voice treats it as an alias for the Kokoro voice id and refuses the build when it disagrees with voice_kokoro — and this series used to set voice='NikBearBrown', a persona name, not a voice id. The persona is carried by channel, folder_chip and greeting_note instead. 09-04-01 and 09-04-02 still carry the old pair and will hit the same refusal if their audio is ever regenerated.
